blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — US President Donald Trump meets with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. in Malacañang, following his assurance of Washington’s full support for the Philippines and other Asean allies. Meanwhile, protests against the US-led Pax Silica initiative greeted Trump upon his arrival in Manila on Tuesday night./dp WATCH: Arrival honors for US President Donal Trump
